text:
maria: Heads-up: planned maintenance tonight 02:00-03:30 UTC on interruptible GPU pool in az3. We'll cordon nodes, do rolling reboots and NIC microcode tweak. Expect ~5-10% capacity dip, short-lived. Tagging @oncall-night.
aj: ETA on node-by-node duration? any live mem-writes to watch for?
maria: ~10–12 min per node for drain+reboot+healthcheck. We have 6 nodes in the cohort. No stateful jobs should be running on these nodes; tenants using long-running pinned pods were notified yesterday.
kevin: Can we shadow traffic to dedicated pool during the window for high-QPS tenants? worried about tail latency spikes.
lia: Yes — plan: scale dedicated-pool up by +2 replicas 30m before, seed KV cache, then scale down after. Autoscaler override: `kubectl scale deploy/dedicated-pool --replicas=4 -n infra` and `sleep 1800` then revert.
sre-bot: Reminder: please attach playbook link and run `preflight-check --region az3` 30m prior.
maria: Playbook: https://confluence.internal/infra/interruptible-maint — includes rollback steps and perf thresholds (p50/p95 token time). If p95 > 400ms for 3 consecutive minutes, abort and failover.
aj: For embeddings jobs: should we pause batch runners to avoid OOM backpressure while nodes are cordoned?
kevin: Good call. Throttle batch-runners by setting `BATCH_CONCURRENCY=0` in k8s cronjob env for the window. Lia can run a quick patch.
lia: I'll patch with k8s rollout: `kubectl patch cronjob embeddings-batch -p '{"spec":{"concurrencyPolicy":"Forbid"}}' -n ml-jobs` and watch logs.
maria: Cost note: using dedicated pool backfill will add ~0.8 GPU-hours — estimate $30 gross for window. We covered this in last cost sync.
kevin: Also we'll enable routing fallback: requests hitting interruptible pool that exceed 300ms go to dedicated variant. Router config: `route: prefer: interruptible, fallback: dedicated, latency_threshold_ms:300`
oncall-night: I'm on duty, will monitor dashboards and PagerDuty. I'll escalate to infra-leads if errors > 1% for 5m.
sre-bot: Auto-post scheduled: Maintenance start at 2025-06-14T02:00Z to #status and status.redwood.com incident page.
maria: Final checklist: 30m preheat KV + scale dedicated, pause embeddings cron, run preflight-check, cordon & drain nodes one at a time, monitor p50/p95, revert patches, announce complete. Any objections?
aj: none from me.
kevin: fine. I'll validate router policy pre-window.
lia: I'll prepare the k8s patch + revert script.
oncall-night: Will be awake and watching. Ping me if latency creeps.
maria: Thanks team — running the preflight at 01:30 UTC and posting status update then. :thumbsup:
